money_categories.description: Account value available for otherwise valid operations.
Value held for a specific escrow obligation.
Bonded value, separate from spendable value.
Value reserved for an explicitly specified fee budget.
Value already transferred by an explicitly authorized rule; no automatic 60-day transfer is defined.

state_invariants.rule: Every live category balance is a nonnegative integer.
live_supply + cumulative_burned equals initial_issued + test_faucet_issued + approved_issuance after every committed transition.
All additions and subtractions are checked; overflow, underflow, or insufficient source value rejects the whole operation without partial mutation.
Each escrow has one unique identifier and at most one terminal monetary outcome.
CLAIM_REQUEST alone never moves escrow value; FINAL_ACCEPT must be authorized by the sender BlackBox and bind the exact claim, receiver, and amount.
SENDER_RECLAIM is valid only under the supplied versioned deadline policy and cannot execute before sender reclaim eligibility.
A stale, duplicate, or conflicting signer nonce cannot cause a second state effect.
An authorization is domain-bound to chain, protocol version, signer, nonce, role, operation, canonical payload, and validity context.
Only deterministic execution of finalized transactions mutates committed ledger state.
Replay of the same initial state, finalized transaction order, and explicit context produces identical state bytes and state root.
After the configured sender reclaim period ends, funds enter POLICY_PENDING; v0.1 performs no automatic reserve transfer or burn.
Recovery pair/run operations have no v0.1 monetary effects until owning recovery security and entitlement issues are resolved.

escrow_transitions.condition: sender-authorized FINAL_ACCEPT satisfies configured receiver-priority policy in explicit finalized context
derive sender reclaim eligibility from configured policy and explicit finalized context
derive post-window status from configured policy and explicit finalized context

property_test_matrix.generator: bounded random valid TRANSFER, LOCK, and settlement operations plus local faucet issuance
values near zero and u128 maximum; assert overflow and underflow are atomic rejections
repeated bytes, altered payloads with same nonce, stale nonce, future nonce, and cross-chain replay
claim request without sender approval, wrong receiver, wrong amount, and approval for a different claim
cutoff-adjacent events under explicit test policies; do not assume a production t0 or clock
interrupt validation at each precondition and verify balances, nonce, escrow, and supply counters are unchanged
same state and finalized operation order across repeated runs; compare canonical bytes and roots
advance test policy beyond sender window and assert POLICY_PENDING with unchanged recipient balances
assert RECOVERY_RUN has no enabled v0.1 monetary transition

unresolved_decisions: Exact receiver-window t0, time source, cutoff inclusivity, and delay compensation.
Production amount width, TONG decimal scale, address format, canonical transaction encoding, cryptographic algorithms, and state-root hash.
Whether a rejected finalized transaction consumes nonce or fees.
Fee budget settlement, reward issuance, validator bond lifecycle, supply cap, genesis, and production issuance.
Legal and consent-safe outcome after the sender reclaim period; reserve transfer is not implemented.
K_R/K_S lifecycle, source signing-key loss, conditional archive decryption, and escrow entitlement through recovery.
